quarterly_data.quarter: Wärtsilä press release: Wrtsil engines selected for major Australian energy (10-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Order (release): Wärtsilä will supply five Wärtsilä 31SG engine generator units for a 59 MW power plant extension in Moomba, South Australia, part of an upgrade by one of Australia's major oil and gas producers that replaces compression at seven gas-driven compressor stations with a single electric-driven station; booked in Q3 2026, engines scheduled for delivery in mid-2027, plus advisory services.
quarterly_data.figure: 59 MW; five Wärtsilä 31SG units; delivery mid-2027
